reviewNote: The operator-authored September 2019 handbook (printed page 11 / PDF page 12) identifies CBR1-A at 19 Battye Street as a third-party location with minimum density of 150 W/ft². NEXTDC’s official Canberra page matches this address to C1. C1 building-level specifications are included only with explicit host-building labels and a scope note; no building totals are assigned to Cyxtera. Current tenancy, Cyxtera allocation and service availability remain unverified.

sources.title: Cyxtera customer handbook v10.13 (operator-authored, hosted by Arrow)
NEXTDC Canberra — C1 address and technical specifications

facts.label: Service presence
facts.value: Cyxtera's September 2019 handbook lists CBR1-A as a third-party location. This identifies a service presence, not a separate Cyxtera-owned building.

facts.label: Specification scope
facts.value: This record describes Cyxtera’s historical CBR1-A service presence at 19 Battye Street. NEXTDC identifies the building as C1 Canberra. Host-building figures below describe NEXTDC C1, not Cyxtera’s allocated space or power. Current Cyxtera tenancy and service availability have not been verified.

facts.label: CBR1-A minimum power density (2019)
facts.value: 150 W/ft², listed in Cyxtera’s September 2019 handbook; historical specification, not a current service commitment.

facts.label: Host building — target IT capacity
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: approximately 4.4 MW across the facility.

facts.label: Host building — technical space
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: 2,260 m²; not Cyxtera’s leased area.

facts.label: Host building — power redundancy
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: minimum N+1 supply redundancy; N+N final distribution to racks.

facts.label: Host building — target PUE
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: 1.4 design target; not a measured current result.

facts.label: Host building — cooling redundancy
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: N+1 water-cooled chillers, cooling towers and pumps; N+2 CRAC units per data hall.

facts.label: Host building — connectivity
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: diverse underground pathways, dedicated interconnect rooms and ICON Fibre access.

facts.label: Host building — physical security
facts.value: NEXTDC C1: onsite security around the clock, biometric access and motion-sensitive CCTV.
